newsitem.title: DENMARK: Becalmed Danish shares close lower, outlook fair.
newsitem.headline: Becalmed Danish shares close lower, outlook fair.

text.p: Danish share prices closed slightly lower on Friday in a quiet market unaffected by the afternoon's better than expected U.S. August jobless data and no reaction expected on Monday either.
"Nothing much has happened here today. A lot of shares have changed hands without causing any notable price changes, the U.S. data won't affect Monday's market," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index closed 0.22 point down at 119.83, while the KFX September future fell 0.10 point to 119.95 with 270 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.

FLS Industries continued its onward progress, closing 13 crowns up at 745, while brewer Carlsberg put on 12 crowns to finish at 345, after announcing an improved first-half 1996 result for its Malaysia operations.
ISS was again the most traded paper, much in focus for overseas investors, with 222,286 shares switching owner to close five down at 154, ending a long run of gains.
Overall turnover for the day was 770 million crowns.
